integrity: Complete analytic proof and a reproducible exact-rational checker are supplied. Finite computations corroborate rather than prove the full theorem; originality is qualified by finite literature scope. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the 2n-point matched-pair family n>=3 and 1<=t<=3; no prescribed optimal embedding dimension or all-optimizer classification. The t=3 crown-graph endpoint follows from an earlier unweighted diameter-three theorem and is not claimed as novel. Earlier equivalent weighted-metric formulations might exist.
title: A three-phase Hilbert distortion law for antipodally deformed crown metrics
